title: Concept: R package that declares no licence restriction
description: DESCRIPTION declares a `License: Unlimited` field, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a `License: Unlimited` field.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through DESCRIPTION (cran).
risk: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a `License: Unlimited` field.
